display_long_description:
Can you handle the height?

Grab, swing and climb your way up in this colorful VR climbing adventure. Dodge deadly traps, outsmart the evil Kryon, free the magical animals he stole – and find out how high you can really go.

🏔 Adventure Mode: Climb through vibrant worlds packed with traps and surprises, from lava caves to a neon galaxy city and the Wild West. Then face Kryon himself in an epic, fully voiced final showdown.

🐾 Rescue the Animals: Kryon has locked magical creatures in cages. Climb to them and set them free, and collect pets that ride along on your hand.

🎲 Surprise Minigames: Get shrunk by magic for a game of Red Light, Green Light, play the magic drums, take a ride in a flying space car and more.

♾️ Endless Mode: How high can you go? Climb above the clouds and into space, beat your best run and chase the top of the leaderboard.

👥 Multiplayer: Climb with up to 6 players in Endless and talk with voice chat. See each other's avatars, hands and pets on the wall.

🏁 NEW – Climb Rush: Race your friends across procedurally generated obstacle courses full of saws, smashers, swinging axes and crumbling holds. First through the portal wins!

🎨 Make It Yours: Avatar heads, hand skins and pets to show off in multiplayer.

🌍 10 languages with voice-overs and subtitles. Comfortable for all ages: no walking, holds within easy reach and smart respawns.

The Kryon finale, extra worlds and many cosmetics are part of the optional Supporter Pack.
